text:
The user requested the results as a CSV string. 

Assistant A provides the data but omits a header row, making the columns ambiguous (though the values are correct).
Assistant B provides a proper CSV format including a header row (`Month,High,Low`), which makes the data much more usable and professional. Both assistants correctly identified the highest and lowest closing prices for the given dates.

Assistant B is better because it includes the header.

[[B]]
